name: Header
summary: Top bar with logo, main navigation and actions. Below 900px the links move into a Slideout behind a menu button. Logo and Navigation are native Figma slots.
use: Websites and apps with a few main sections.
avoid: Apps with many sections or deep navigation: use Sidebar.
figmaProps: Logo holds a _Logo instance (Size=Large, tagline off). Select it in the slot to turn the tagline on or to swap in your own logo.
reactProps: icon is used in the mobile menu.
behaviour: Desktop: links in the bar. Mobile: the menu button opens a Slideout with the same links.
a11y: <header> with a <nav aria-label>. Current page with aria-current="page".
The menu button has aria-expanded and aria-haspopup="dialog".
content: 5 to 6 links at most, with short names.
do: Keep the same order on desktop and mobile.
dont: Mix actions and navigation in the row of links.
open: Dropdowns under main links (mega menu) are not there yet.
